draft.subject: Next step after our getting started call
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks for making time for the getting started call last week. The natural next step is your first project in Wrenfield -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and once it's there you can invite the rest of the Timber Systems team from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you live, or answer anything by reply.

Best,
Chidi
